backgroundPanel.title: Background layer
backgroundPanel.lead: Stack solid, image, and pattern layers behind the workspace grid. Click Apply to sync to the panel and save.
backgroundPanel.emptyLayers: No layers yet — add one with the buttons on the left.
backgroundPanel.selectLayer: Select a layer in the list to edit it.

widgetSelector.title: Add widget
widgetSelector.lead: Choose a type and send it to the main workspace panel. Supported items add a tile at the bottom of the grid.
widgetSelector.addToPanelHint: Add this widget to the main panel grid (bottom row).
widgetSelector.notInPanelYet: This widget type does not have a panel UI yet — it cannot be placed.
widgetSelector.footerHint: Grayed items are not yet implemented in the panel renderer. Others close this dialog after sending the request.
